description: Fetches cruise itinerary details, pricing, and sailing dates from Viking Cruises (vikingcruises.com) for ocean, river, and expedition cruises.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_cruise_details: 获取邮轮行程详情，包括停靠港口、天数、包含项目等; 参数: cruise_name, region, start_location, end_location, year, product_line, url; 必填: 无
  - get_pricing: 获取邮轮价格和出发日期信息; 参数: cruise_name, region, start_location, end_location, year, product_line, url; 必填: 无
  - search_cruises: 搜索邮轮（返回已知邮轮信息）; 参数: region, product_line; 必填: 无

cruise_name.description:
邮轮名称的URL slug。
示例: alaska-inside-passage

region.description:
邮轮所在地区的URL slug。
示例: caribbean-americas, mediterranean, scandinavia

start_location.description:
出发港口的URL slug。
示例: vancouver-british-columbia, barcelona

end_location.description:
结束港口的URL slug。
示例: seward, rome

product_line.description:
Viking产品线类型。
可用值: oceans, rivers, expeditions

url.description:
邮轮页面的完整URL。可以代替单独的参数使用。
示例: https://www.vikingcruises.com/oceans/cruise-destinations/caribbean-americas/alaska-inside-passage/index.html?startLocation=vancouver-british-columbia&endLocation=seward&year=2028
